title: GeneLab NF_MAAgilent1ch parameters
description: NASA GeneLab Agilent 1 Channel Microarray Workflow for Pipeline Document GL-DPPD-7112-A

basic_options.title: Basic options
basic_options.description: Basic options for the pipeline, typically set on the command line.

osdAccession.description: the OSD accession ID for the OSDR dataset

gldsAccession.description: the GLDS accession ID for the OSDR dataset

resultsDir.description: location for output from the workflow (including raw data and metadata)

advanced_options.title: Advanced options
advanced_options.description: Advanced options for the pipeline, typically set in a config file.

biomart_attribute.description: Manually sets a value for the biomart_attribute column in the runsheet if the 'Array design REF' column is not present in the ISA file.

isaArchivePath.description: path to ISA archive (alternative to automatically downloading from OSDR)

annotation_file_path.description: path to GeneLab annotation reference file linking organisms to annotation files

limit_biomart_query.description: Queries the first N BioMart IDs if set to a number > 0. Useful for testing the workflow with a limited number of IDs. If set to 0, all IDs will be queried.

max_flag_code.description: Maximum flag value allowed, exceeding this value during V&V will cause the workflow to halt

workflow_configuration.title: Workflow configuration
workflow_configuration.description: Less common options for the pipeline, typically set in a config file.

publish_dir_mode.description: Nextflow publishDir mode for handling output files

trace_report_suffix.description: Suffix to add to the trace report filename. Default is the date and time in the format yyyy-MM-dd_HH-mm-ss.
